title: 金鯱賞の後に・『運の尽き』

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wait… I lost? How could that be?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What could have happened? Wasn't luck working in my favor? Just… what?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: This can't be right. It has to be a trick. I mean, this can't really be happening. I have a destiny…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: What's going on, Trainer? I must still be asleep. This is all just a terrible nightmare, right?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: It can't be real! I thought I'd been reborn… This means I haven't changed one bit…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Where has my luck gone?! Is it in hibernation or something?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Wake up! Please, I'm begging you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: If the gods have deserted me, then what should I… I… Waaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A worried Silence Suzuka tries comforting her, but I gently turn her down, sensing this isn't the right time. Matikanefukukitaru continues to cry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her that our next goal is the Takarazuka Kinen. She doesn't respond.
